summary: Iteration-34: End-to-end OUT-OF-WARRANTY hearing-aid repair workflow walked from RECEIVE through CLOSED across v1+v2 endpoints. 15/16 tests pass, 1 XFAIL surfaces Bug A. Two additional critical bugs surfaced during execution: Bug B (multi-tenant counter collision causing 500 on courier booking) and Bug C (invoice GST behaviour disagrees with the spec).

critical.endpoint: POST /api/ha/couriers (and any next_number()-minted ID with a globally-unique index)
critical.issue: Bug B — Multi-tenant numbering collision. `next_number()` namespaces counters per (kind, clinic, year) but the `ha_courier_shipments.shipment_id_1` Mongo index is GLOBALLY unique. Observed live: counter `courier:tenant-sound-clinic-blr:2026` was at seq=2 → minted `CSH-2026-0002`, which already existed under `clinic-pytest-suite` → DuplicateKeyError → HTTP 500 with generic 'Internal server error'. Same shape applies to every numbered entity whose unique index is on the ID alone instead of (clinic_id, id).

Bug C — Invoice generator hardcodes `gst_inclusive=False` (ha_service_v2.py:640) when synthesising the pseudo InvoiceLineCreate. Estimate `conveyed_amount=3000` therefore becomes ex-GST → invoice subtotal=3000, tax=540, grand_total=3540. The iter-34 spec expects the conveyed amount to be GST-INCLUSIVE (subtotal=2542.37, tax=457.63, grand=3000). Either honour InvoiceLineCreate.gst_inclusive (recently added per Bug 2 fix) or default it to True for service invoices.

Bug A confirmed — Server silently accepts `warranty_covered=true` on a serial whose `warranty_end_date` is 6 months in the past. There is no cross-check between the payload flag and the bound serial's warranty window, so an audiologist can accidentally (or fraudulently) flag an OOW repair as in-warranty. Recommend rejecting with 422 OR force-overriding the flag based on serial state.

v1/v2 workflow coherence — v1 /resolve is gated to legacy status='in_progress' (FWD_TRANSITIONS). After a v2 walk that legitimately ends in READY_FOR_PICKUP, /resolve still fires because the legacy map normalises 'in_progress'≡REPAIR_IN_PROGRESS — so the v1 hook DID run in this test and produced status='resolved'. But this is fragile: any v2 sequence that ends in a non-mapped state (e.g. DELIVERED_TO_CLIENT) will silently bypass v1's serial SERVICE_IN→RETURNED hand-off. v2 /transition has NO equivalent serial-state hook. Recommendation: hoist the serial-state side-effect into the v2 transition handler at READY_FOR_PICKUP/DELIVERED_TO_CLIENT and deprecate v1 /resolve+/close, OR document that callers MUST chain both.

minor.issue: Re-POST at terminal state (CLOSED) did not create a duplicate in this run, but the endpoint has no explicit early-return on ticket.invoice_id — code path relies on state guards. Recommend an explicit short-circuit returning the existing invoice for idempotency safety.
Returns `{"user": {...}, "clinic": {...}}` — earlier iterations expected branch_ids at top level. Not a bug, just worth pinning in the API contract.

Counter for `courier:tenant-sound-clinic-blr:2026` was at seq=2 in a freshly-running env even though `clinic-pytest-suite` already owned CSH-2026-0001/2/3 — this means the test-suite tenant has been inserting WITHOUT the global guard for some prior run, OR a previous insert succeeded but counter wasn't bumped. Inspect for race condition between insert + counter increment.

action_items: Bug B (CRITICAL): make `ha_courier_shipments.shipment_id` index (clinic_id, shipment_id) instead of global, OR have next_number() namespace include something globally-unique (e.g. clinic prefix in the printed ID). Audit ALL next_number()-minted entities (invoices, jobs, estimates, approvals, payments) for the same global-unique-index footgun.

Bug C (HIGH): in ha_service_v2.py around line 640, either pass `gst_inclusive=True` for service invoices generated from an estimate.conveyed_amount, or expose this as a tenant setting. Spec expects 3000 inclusive → subtotal=2542.37, tax=457.63.

Bug A (HIGH): add server-side validation in POST /api/ha/service-tickets that compares payload.warranty_covered against the bound serial's warranty_end_date. Either reject with 422 or force-correct + return a warning. Suggested message: 'Serial X warranty ended on YYYY-MM-DD; warranty_covered flag overridden to false.'

v1/v2 coherence (HIGH): decide on a single canonical lifecycle. If keeping both, move the serial SERVICE_IN→RETURNED side-effect out of v1 /resolve into v2 /transition (trigger on READY_FOR_PICKUP or DELIVERED_TO_CLIENT). Add a deprecation header on /resolve + /close.
Make POST /api/ha/service-tickets/{ticket_no}/invoice strictly idempotent: short-circuit on existing ticket.invoice_id.
critical_code_review_comments: ha_service_v2.py:640 — pseudo-InvoiceLineCreate hardcodes gst_inclusive=False, defeating the recently-added gst_inclusive wire flag and silently shifting invoice totals.
ha_couriers index (clinic_id, awb_number, direction) IS unique-per-tenant, but `shipment_id_1` is unique GLOBALLY — inconsistent uniqueness model.

next_number() does not atomically insert+bump — if an insert with the minted id fails (any reason), the counter is still advanced (or worse, the doc was inserted by another clinic). Suggest using `find_one_and_update` with `upsert` plus a retry loop on DuplicateKeyError.
v1 /resolve uses legacy 'in_progress' status while v2 /transition uses REPAIR_IN_PROGRESS — works today only because LEGACY_STATUS_MAP papers over it. Brittle.
Server trusts client-supplied `warranty_covered` boolean with no cross-check against the serial's warranty window — security/billing-integrity risk.
